about: The store families that may be opened as a DELTA over a read-only REFERENCE (EC2/EC3, build-store economy, 2026-10-25). countedTableName is the family's address table: its row count is stamped when the delta is made and must never be lower when the delta is opened again (the reference is append-only; a smaller one is not the store the delta was built over). sequenceColumnName, when present, is the family's append order: its maximum is stamped too, so a fold can tell a reference row written AFTER the delta was made from one written before.
